name: Scientist (Vargr)
description: These individuals are trained in scientific methods to investigate situations, research phenomena and develop new technologies and materials.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: You are a physician or surgeon.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: You are a researcher for a corporate or government organisation.

technician.name: Technician
technician.description: You are a technician or assistant in a team of scientists or engineers.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: A lab accident exposes you to a dangerous substance. Lose END −1.
mishaps.3: An experiment goes critically wrong and causes the death of several pack members. You are forced to leave this career and lose SOC −1.
mishaps.4: You are assigned to an off-world laboratory but your ship crashes en route. Gain Survival 1 and roll END 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.5: Your employers cancel your research. You may continue this career but gain no Benefit rolls this term. Alternatively, roll SOC 8+: if successful, you continue your work with another pack and stay in this career but gain an Enemy of your previous employer. If you fail, you are forced to leave this career.
mishaps.6: A rival scientist discredits you or steals your research. Gain a Rival, lose SOC −1 and suffer DM-2 to your next Survival roll.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are assigned to a military project. Gain a Contact and one of Gun Combat 1, Engineer 1, Heavy Weapons 1 or Science 1.
events.4: You are singled out and assigned to work on a secret project and forbidden to discuss it with anyone, even members of your pack. Gain Deception 1.
events.5: You are assigned to an orbiting laboratory or lab ship. Gain one level in Vacc Suit or Athletics (Dexterity).
events.6: You are given advanced training. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one level in any skill you are eligible for in this career.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: You work with several institutes and research facilities. Gain a number of Contacts equal to your SOC modifier (minimum 1).
events.9: You become friends with a brilliant but eccentric mentor. Gain an Ally and one level in any Science skill.
events.10: You make a minor scientific discovery. Gain SOC +1 and DM+1 to a Benefit roll from this career.
events.11: You work for a prestigious organisation. Gain DM+1 to a Benefit roll from this career and DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You make a scientific breakthrough. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.
